extDescription.message: Select text on any page to translate it, or right-click to translate the whole page. Uses Chrome's built-in on-device translation by default, no API key needed.

errUnknown.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errTimeout.message: No response for too long. Please try again later.

errEmptyBuiltin.message: The translation came back empty. Try different text.

errEmptyAI.message: The translation came back empty. Try different text or check the model settings.

errNoResponse.message: Couldn't get a translation. Reload the extension and try again.

errExtensionUpdated.message: The extension was updated. Reload this page and try again.

errNoBuiltin.message: This version of Chrome has no built-in translation. Update desktop Chrome, or choose another engine in the settings.

errNoDetector.message: Chrome can't detect languages on this device. Choose another engine in the settings.

errUnknownSource.message: Couldn't tell which language this is. Try selecting a longer sentence.

errPairUnsupported.message: Chrome doesn't support this language pair yet. Choose another engine in the settings.

errPackFailed.message: The language pack failed to download. Check your connection and try again.

pageNeedsBuiltin.message: Full-page translation needs Chrome's built-in translation

pageNeedsBuiltinSub.message: Use desktop Chrome 138 or later, or switch to an AI model in the settings.

pageNothing.message: Nothing on this page needs translating

pageAlready.message: This page is already in $P1$. Nothing to translate.

pageNeedDetector.message: Language detection needs to be set up

pageNeedDetectorSub.message: Click to start; translation begins when it's ready.

pageUnknownLang.message: Couldn't tell which language this page is in

pageFirstTimeSub.message: A language pack needs to download once.

pagePackFailed.message: The language pack failed to download

pagePackFailedSub.message: Check your connection and try again.

errReloadForBuiltin.message: Reload this page to use Chrome's built-in translation.

errModelCustomGone.message: Model “$P1$” wasn't found. Check the model name under Advanced in the settings, or clear it to use the default.

errModelGone.message: $P1$ has retired the model “$P2$”, or it's unavailable right now. Update the extension, or enter another model name under Advanced in the settings.

toggleOnDesc.message: A Translate button appears next to selected text

toggleOffDesc.message: Paused. No button appears when you select text

engineBuiltinDesc.message: Chrome built-in · no key · text stays on your device

engineAIDesc.message: Reads the context for better results · needs an API key

builtinInfo.message: The first time you use a language, Chrome downloads a language pack.

keyUnsaved.message: The key isn't saved yet. It takes effect after you click Save.

keyStoredSync.message: The key is kept in your Chrome sync storage and sent only to $P1$.

keyStoredLocal.message: The key is kept only on this computer and sent only to $P1$.

keyMissing.message: Until you save a key, translations use Chrome's built-in translation.

keyLocalOnly.message: Keep keys on this computer only (don't sync)

customModelHelp.message: If the provider retires the default model, enter a new model name here. Leave empty to use the default.

welcomeLead.message: Thanks for installing Context Translator. Three things to know, one minute to learn.

translatorFirstUse.message: Ready (Chrome $P1$). The first time you translate a language, Chrome downloads a language pack.

translatorMissing.message: Needs desktop Chrome 138 or later; you have Chrome $P1$. You can use an AI model in the settings instead.

translatorPairMissing.message: Chrome on this computer doesn't support your target language yet. Pick another one, or use an AI model.

stepSelectDesc.message: The translation appears in a small card. With an AI model, select a single word to see what it means in that sentence.

stepPageTitle.message: Right-click a page and choose “Translate full page”

stepPageDesc.message: Only the paragraphs you can see are translated, more as you scroll. Use the bar at the bottom right to switch to side by side or restore the page.

stepSettingsTitle.message: Click the “文” toolbar icon for settings

stepSettingsDesc.message: Change the target language or connect your own AI model. Tip: pin it to the toolbar from the puzzle-piece menu.

tryHint.message: Try it here: select a sentence below, double-click the word “bank”, or right-click and choose “Translate full page”

kicker.description: Small line above the title; shows the other-language name
